source_text: These benefits include a 90% reduction in urinary tract infections (UTIs) during the first year of life, a 3- to 10-fold decrease in penile cancer risk over the lifetime, and lowered transmission of heterosexual HIV (by 50-60% based on randomized trials), human papillomavirus, and herpes simplex virus type 2.
